name: Hamza bin Laden
role: Al-Qaeda propagandist and designated heir to Osama bin Laden (messages 2015-2019)
summary: Hamza bin Laden's only public record is a handful of audio messages released by al-Qaeda from 2015, plus family letters. They call for a shari'a-ruled Islamic order won by armed uprising against rulers he calls tyrants, reject elections and parliaments, urge attacks on Jews, Americans and Western states, and cast Jerusalem and Syria as causes of the whole Muslim community. He said nothing on most economic, social or technological questions.

sources.title: Hamza bin Ladin, "The Fighter Against Invaders And The Inciter of Rebellion Against Tyrants" (7 Nov 2017), As-Sahab English transcript
sources.author: Hamza bin Laden; reproduced by Kyle Orton
sources.usedFor: Full transcript downloaded and read: shari'a sovereignty, rejection of elections and parliaments, armed revolt, corruption, praise of his father.

sources.title: Hamza bin Ladin, "The Cause of al-Sham is the Cause of Islam" (14 Sep 2017), As-Sahab English transcript
sources.author: Hamza bin Laden; reproduced by Kyle Orton
sources.usedFor: Full transcript downloaded and read: Syria, the International System, Crusader-Rafidi enemies, Jerusalem, America and Russia.

sources.title: Hamza bin Ladin, letter on the martyrdom of his son (Jan 2018)
sources.author: Hamza bin Laden; reproduced by Kyle Orton
sources.usedFor: Read in full; personal letter on martyrdom and family, no answer to any statement.

sources.title: Hamza bin Ladin: From Steadfast Son to Al-Qa`ida's Leader in Waiting
sources.author: Ali Soufan, CTC Sentinel (Sept 2017)
sources.usedFor: Quotations and summaries of his 2015-2017 messages (lone-wolf attacks, Jewish and Western targets, Saudi regime change, US 'stealing' Muslim wealth).

sources.title: Hamza bin Laden's Rise in al Qaeda
sources.author: Colin Neafsey, AEI Critical Threats Project (22 Nov 2017)
sources.usedFor: Dated summary of each of his statements, 2015-2017; used for context and Saudi-regime messages.
